mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses equity discount rates and drives capital allocation toward equities, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek yield in a low-rate environment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers immediate market repricing toward tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), labor market tightness accelerates wage growth and corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC for UNRATE signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly payroll growth consistently supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings momentum builds.
failure_condition: Positive 20d returns occur in less than 55% of instances with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 104.0 (index 2017=100) signals weakening economic activity and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as risk aversion increases.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 104.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth and housing starts expansion signal robust aggregate demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y) with low rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the central bank's inability to combat inflation while keeping rates low triggers recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.
